question: What engagement models does Vesharo offer?
answer: We offer two transparent engagement models: (1) Sprint-Based Fixed Scope for projects with well-defined deliverables and milestones, and (2) Dedicated Engineering Squad for ongoing product development where you get a dedicated team of architects, full-stack engineers, and DevOps specialists working directly in your workflow.

question: Who owns the code and intellectual property produced?
answer: You own 100% of all intellectual property, source code, database schemas, architecture documents, and deployment configurations from day one. Full rights and git repository access belong exclusively to your organization upon milestone delivery.

question: What core technologies and architectures do you specialize in?
answer: Our stack centers on battle-tested, high-performance modern technologies: TypeScript, React, Astro, Next.js, Node.js, Go, Python (for AI orchestration and data processing), PostgreSQL, Redis, Docker, and AWS / Google Cloud infrastructure.

question: How do you ensure data security and prevent data leaks in AI systems?
answer: We enforce strict security perimeters: zero customer data retention agreements with model providers, private VPC deployments, role-based access controls, and deterministic validation layers that prevent hallucinations before outputs hit user-facing systems.

question: What does a typical project timeline look like from kickoff to launch?
answer: Every engagement starts with a 1-week technical discovery sprint to align architecture and specs. Production-ready MVPs typically ship in 3 to 6 weeks. Larger enterprise platforms follow 2-week agile delivery cycles with working, tested builds demonstrated at every sprint boundary.

question: Do you provide post-launch support and uptime maintenance?
answer: Yes. Every production deployment includes a complimentary 30-day post-launch warranty. Afterwards, we offer monthly SLA agreements covering 24/7 uptime monitoring, critical security patching, API maintenance, dependency upgrades, and ongoing iterative improvements.

question: How do you handle daily communication and project management?
answer: You communicate directly with our senior technical leads via Slack or Microsoft Teams. We conduct weekly sprint reviews, provide daily async progress summaries, and track every deliverable transparently in ClickUp or GitHub Projects.

question: How do you ensure code quality and avoid regressions?
answer: Every project includes automated CI/CD pipelines with comprehensive linting, type-checking, unit tests, and end-to-end integration tests. We require code reviews on all pull requests and conduct manual cross-device verification before deployment.

question: Do you charge fixed price or time and materials?
answer: We prefer fixed-price milestone delivery for well-scoped sprints because it gives you budget certainty with zero billing surprises. For evolving, fast-moving products, our dedicated squad model operates on a predictable monthly sprint rate.

question: Can you audit, refactor, or take over an existing codebase?
answer: Yes. We frequently conduct code quality and architecture audits for companies experiencing performance bottlenecks, excessive technical debt, or scalability limits. We provide a clear remediation plan and execute refactoring iteratively without halting current business operations.

question: Are cloud hosting and third-party API costs included in your fees?
answer: Cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP, Vercel) and third-party API costs (OpenAI, Resend, Twilio) are billed directly to your own corporate cloud accounts. This ensures you maintain direct billing control, data ownership, and cost transparency with no markup.

question: What kind of autonomous AI agents can you build for our business?
answer: We build domain-specific AI agents that automate complex knowledge workflows: customer support triage, document verification, automated lead qualification, ERP/CRM data sync, multi-step research synthesis, and API integration agents with deterministic tool-calling.

question: Do you build native mobile apps or cross-platform solutions?
answer: We primarily engineer cross-platform mobile apps using React Native and Flutter, achieving 95%+ shared code efficiency with 60 FPS native performance, biometric authentication, offline database synchronization, and seamless camera/hardware integrations.

question: Do your websites and web applications comply with accessibility laws?
answer: Yes. All web applications we engineer target WCAG 2.2 AA accessibility standards by default, featuring semantic HTML, full keyboard navigability, high-contrast color ratios, aria attributes, and screen-reader friendliness.

question: How do you handle legacy software modernization?
answer: We follow the Strangler Fig pattern: identifying high-value modules in your legacy system, re-architecting them into modern microservices or decoupled Astro/React interfaces, and systematically retiring legacy components with zero business downtime.

question: What timezones does your engineering team support?
answer: Our engineering headquarters is in Ahmedabad, India (IST), but our delivery squads maintain overlapping working hours with clients across North America (EST/PST), the United Kingdom (GMT), and Europe (CET) to guarantee real-time collaboration.

question: What security practices do you follow during software development?
answer: We implement OWASP Top 10 security guardrails, automated dependency vulnerability scans, encrypted secrets management (never hardcoded in repos), HTTPS-only enforcement, and strict data sanitization across all API endpoints.

question: Will you set up automated CI/CD deployment pipelines for our team?
answer: Yes. Every production build includes automated GitHub Actions or GitLab CI pipelines that run test suites, lint checks, build verifications, and deploy to staging and production cloud environments with zero manual intervention.

question: How quickly can Vesharo kick off a new engagement?
answer: Once the initial technical discovery call is completed and project scope or sprint agreement is approved, our technical squad can spin up environments and begin active engineering within 3 to 5 business days.

question: What does the final handoff and knowledge transfer process include?
answer: At project completion, we deliver comprehensive documentation: system architecture diagrams, API specifications, environment setup manuals, walkthrough video recordings, and conducted live training sessions for your internal engineering staff.

question: Will you sign a non-disclosure agreement (NDA) before we discuss details?
answer: Yes, absolutely. We routinely execute mutual NDAs prior to reviewing proprietary product roadmaps, business workflows, architecture diagrams, or confidential datasets.

question: How do we get started with Vesharo?
answer: Simply reach out via our contact page or email contact@vesharo.com. We schedule a 30-minute discovery consultation with a senior technical architect to analyze your requirements, evaluate feasibility, and outline a clear action plan.
